== English errata comparison sources ==
The November 1998 glossary allows a react to the same system or sector. The first and June 2023 Holotable composites use that same wording. The intervening PC face recorded 1 April 2023 UTC removes “your” from the Alter immunity. The latest checked PC face restores “your” and changes the trigger to “about to be lost.” The June 2023 composite restores the Decipher wording and is documented on its existing article in Versions. The dates are repository attestations. The 2023-04-01 UTC image is from commit 15fe0698ce5c2eed581ddf1a3f1088c631618c40 and the 2026-07-29 image is from commit 9e33f3d368cb2048a43291d3401336cc9569a3f9.
